title: Bioluminescence Luciferin-Luciferase Enzyme Reaction Glow Lab
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that simulates a bioluminescence chemistry lab where the user performs a luciferin-luciferase enzyme reaction and observes the resulting glow. The scene must be scientifically grounded and interactive.

## Scene Setup
- Dark chemistry lab environment with a perspective camera at position (0, 4, 8) looking at origin.
- Ambient light at intensity 0.05 (very dim lab) and one weak directional light (intensity 0.15) simulating emergency/safety lighting.
- A lab bench (box geometry, dark grey) centered at y=0.
- Three reagent bottles on the bench, each a cylinder with a colored cap:
  1. Luciferin bottle (yellow cap, label 'D-Luciferin') at x=-2
  2. Luciferase enzyme bottle (blue cap, label 'Luciferase') at x=0
  3. ATP cofactor bottle (green cap, label 'ATP + Mg²⁺') at x=2
- A transparent glass beaker (cylinder with MeshPhysicalMaterial, transmission=0.9) at position (0, 1.2, 2) on the bench. This is the reaction vessel.
- A magnetic stirrer base under the beaker with a visible stir bar inside.
- A spectrophotometer device (box with a small screen) at x=4 on the bench.

## Reaction Chemistry Model
Model the bioluminescence reaction: Luciferin + O₂ + ATP → (Luciferase catalyst) → Oxyluciferin + CO₂ + AMP + PPi + LIGHT (λ peak ~560nm).
- Track moles of each reagent: luciferin, luciferase, atp. Each addition adds 0.5 mmol.
- The reaction rate follows Michaelis-Menten kinetics: rate = Vmax * [luciferin] / (Km + [luciferin]), where Vmax depends on [luciferase] and [ATP] availability.
- Use Vmax = 0.1 * min([luciferase], [atp]) mmol/s, Km = 0.25 mmol.
- Reaction only proceeds when all three reagents are present and stirring is active.
- Track product oxyluciferin accumulation. Total moles must be conserved: luciferin_initial = luciferin_remaining + oxyluciferin_produced (within epsilon 1e-6).
- Light intensity (photon output) is proportional to reaction rate. Peak emission wavelength = 560nm (map to yellow-green color #AAFF00).
- Temperature affects reaction: default 25°C. User can adjust 10-50°C. Rate multiplier = 2^((T-25)/10) (Q10 rule).

## Glow Effect
- When reaction proceeds, the beaker contents glow yellow-green. Implement using a PointLight inside the beaker whose intensity = reactionRate * 50, color #AAFF00.
- Add emissive material to the liquid mesh inside the beaker. Emissive intensity tracks reaction rate.
- Particle system: small glowing particles rise from the liquid surface (representing photon emission), count proportional to reaction rate, max 200 particles.

## User Interactions
1. Click on a reagent bottle, then click on the beaker to add that reagent (0.5 mmol per addition). Highlight selected bottle with outline.
2. Press 'S' to toggle the magnetic stirrer on/off. Stir bar rotates visually when on.
3. Press 'T' then Up/Down arrows to adjust temperature (±1°C per press). Press 'T' again to exit temperature mode.
4. Click the spectrophotometer to take a reading of current emission wavelength and intensity.
5. Press 'R' to reset the entire experiment (all reagents back to 0, glow off, temperature to 25°C).
6. Press 'U' to undo the last reagent addition (remove 0.5 mmol of the last-added reagent, if reaction hasn't consumed it yet).
7. DOM button 'Toggle UV' that switches a UV lamp on/off. UV lamp (blacklight, color #4400AA) at intensity 2.0 reveals fluorescent labels on bottles.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left HUD panel showing: Luciferin (mmol), Luciferase (mmol), ATP (mmol), Oxyluciferin (mmol), Reaction Rate (mmol/s), Temperature (°C), Stirrer (ON/OFF).
- A 'Toggle UV' button styled as a lab switch (bottom-right).
- Spectrophotometer reading display (shows 'Peak λ: 560nm, Intensity: X' after clicking it).
- Conservation check display: shows 'Mass Conservation: ✓' or '✗' in the HUD.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- luciferinMoles: number (current mmol in beaker)
- luciferaseMoles: number
- atpMoles: number
- oxyluciferinMoles: number (product)
- reactionRate: number (current mmol/s)
- glowIntensity: number (PointLight intensity value)
- temperature: number (°C)
- stirrerActive: boolean
- selectedBottle: string|null ('luciferin','luciferase','atp', or null)
- reagentAdditions: array of strings (history of additions in order)
- totalLuciferinAdded: number (cumulative luciferin added)
- conservationError: number (absolute difference: totalLuciferinAdded - luciferinMoles - oxyluciferinMoles)
- conservationValid: boolean (conservationError < 1e-6)
- uvLampOn: boolean
- uvLightIntensity: number
- spectrometerReading: {wavelength: number, intensity: number} or null
- particleCount: number (active glow particles)
- temperatureMode: boolean (whether T-adjust mode is active)
- peakEmissionWavelength: number (always 560)
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since first reagent added)
- reactionStarted: boolean (true once all 3 reagents present and stirrer on)
- lastAction: string (description of last user action)

Animate at 60fps. Use requestAnimationFrame. Reaction simulation should use delta-time for frame-rate independence.
physics_constraints: Michaelis-Menten kinetics: rate = Vmax * [S] / (Km + [S]) with Vmax = 0.1 * min([luciferase],[atp]), Km = 0.25. Q10 temperature rule: rateMultiplier = 2^((T-25)/10). Strict mass conservation: totalLuciferinAdded === luciferinMoles + oxyluciferinMoles within 1e-6. Reaction only proceeds when all three reagents > 0 and stirrer is active. Glow intensity proportional to reaction rate. No NaN values permitted in any state field.
